metadata.browsePolicy:
WITH approved_guides AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT browse_current_guide_prices_set_v1.supplier_id,
            browse_current_guide_prices_set_v1.supplier_sku,
            browse_current_guide_prices_set_v1.guide_minor
           FROM curtainsuk_private.browse_current_guide_prices_set_v1
        ), media_eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT m_1.fabric_id,
            m_1.supplier_id,
            m_1.supplier_sku
           FROM curtainsuk_private.fabric_media_mappings m_1
             JOIN curtainsuk_private.fabric_media_assets a USING (content_hash)
          WHERE m_1.rights_state = 'APPROVED'::text AND m_1.mapping_state = 'VERIFIED'::text AND a.width > 0 AND a.height > 0 AND a.shopify_cdn_url ~ '^https://cdn[.]shopify[.]com/[^?#]+$'::text
        ), latest_stock AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_id, daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_sku) daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_id,
            daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_sku,
            daily_stock_snapshots.snapshot_date,
            daily_stock_snapshots.checked_at,
            daily_stock_snapshots.lifecycle_state,
            daily_stock_snapshots.aggregate_metres
           FROM curtainsuk_private.daily_stock_snapshots
          ORDER BY daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_id, daily_stock_snapshots.supplier_sku, daily_stock_snapshots.snapshot_date DESC
        ), stock_balance AS MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT st.supplier_id,
            st.supplier_sku,
            st.checked_at,
            st.lifecycle_state,
            st.aggregate_metres,
            COALESCE(sum(u.metres), 0::numeric) AS used_metres
           FROM latest_stock st
             LEFT JOIN curtainsuk_private.daily_stock_usage u ON u.supplier_id = st.supplier_id AND u.supplier_sku = st.supplier_sku AND u.confirmed_at >= st.checked_at
          GROUP BY st.supplier_id, st.supplier_sku, st.checked_at, st.lifecycle_state, st.aggregate_metres
        )
 SELECT c.fabric_id,
    c.supplier_id,
    c.supplier_sku,
    g.guide_minor,
    c.colour_name,
    b.display_name AS brand,
    d.display_name AS design,
    co.display_name AS collection,
    r.window_types,
    curtainsuk_private.manufacturer_colour_families(c.colour_name) AS manufacturer_colour_families,
    lower(COALESCE((vk.visual_fields -> 'primaryColour'::text) ->> 'value'::text, ''::text)) AS visual_primary_colour,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof((vk.visual_fields -> 'secondaryColours'::text) -> 'value'::text) = 'array'::text THEN COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(lower(x.value)) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((vk.visual_fields -> 'secondaryColours'::text) -> 'value'::text) x(value)), '[]'::jsonb)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS visual_secondary_colours,
    lower(COALESCE((vk.visual_fields -> 'patternClass'::text) ->> 'value'::text, ''::text)) AS pattern_class,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof((vk.visual_fields -> 'motif'::text) -> 'value'::text) = 'array'::text THEN COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(lower(x.value)) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((vk.visual_fields -> 'motif'::text) -> 'value'::text) x(value)), '[]'::jsonb)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS motif,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof((vk.visual_fields -> 'visualSurface'::text) -> 'value'::text) = 'array'::text THEN COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(lower(x.value)) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((vk.visual_fields -> 'visualSurface'::text) -> 'value'::text) x(value)), '[]'::jsonb)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS visual_surface,
    lower(COALESCE((vk.visual_fields -> 'sheenAppearance'::text) ->> 'value'::text, ''::text)) AS sheen_appearance,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof((vk.visual_fields -> 'character'::text) -> 'value'::text) = 'array'::text THEN COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(lower(x.value)) AS jsonb_agg
               FROM jsonb_array_elements_text((vk.visual_fields -> 'character'::text) -> 'value'::text) x(value)), '[]'::jsonb)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END AS visual_character,
    COALESCE(stock.checked_at <= now() AND stock.lifecycle_state <> 'DISCONTINUED'::text AND (stock.aggregate_metres - stock.used_metres) >= 30::numeric, false) AS stock_current,
    COALESCE(stock.checked_at <= now() AND stock.lifecycle_state <> 'DISCONTINUED'::text AND (stock.aggregate_metres - stock.used_metres) > 0::numeric, false) AS sample_current,
    COALESCE(stock.checked_at <= now(), false) AS stock_known
   FROM curtainsuk_private.fabric_colourways c
     JOIN media_eligible m ON m.fabric_id = c.fabric_id AND m.supplier_id = c.supplier_id AND m.supplier_sku = c.supplier_sku
     LEFT JOIN approved_guides g ON g.supplier_id = c.supplier_id AND g.supplier_sku = c.supplier_sku
     JOIN curtainsuk_private.supplier_brands b ON b.brand_id = c.brand_id
     JOIN curtainsuk_private.fabric_designs d ON d.design_id = c.design_id
     JOIN curtainsuk_private.fabric_collections co ON co.collection_id = d.collection_id
     LEFT JOIN curtainsuk_private.fabric_retail_profiles r ON r.fabric_id = c.fabric_id
     LEFT JOIN curtainsuk_private.fabric_visual_knowledge_enriched vk ON vk.fabric_id = c.fabric_id AND (vk.knowledge_state = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETE'::text, 'PARTIAL_GOVERNED'::text]))
     LEFT JOIN stock_balance stock ON stock.supplier_id = c.supplier_id AND stock.supplier_sku = c.supplier_sku AND stock.checked_at >= (now() - curtainsuk_private.stock_validity_window())
  WHERE c.staging_catalog_visible AND c.lifecycle_state <> 'DISCONTINUED'::text AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.supplier_sku)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM c.colour_name)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.display_name)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM d.display_name)) > 0;
